title: Chickpea and Tuna Salad
ingredients: 145g (5oz) can of tuna chunks in spring water, drained
400g (14oz) can of chickpeas, drained and rinsed
1 red pepper, deseeded and finely chopped
small handful of parsley leaves, finely chopped
method: In a large bowl, use a fork to mash the tuna up with the vinegar, mustard, garlic and some salt and pepper.
Mix in the chickpeas to fully coat with the tuna and dressing.
Add the red pepper, courgette, spring onions and parsley and toss them in.
notes: Any crunchy, fresh vegetables will work well — try green beans, sugarsnap peas, broccoli, lettuce, radishes or cucumber. Stir in some pre-cooked grains such as bulgur wheat or couscous to bulk it up.
